name: RBA Autoexec Manager
behavior: Leaves only the active rba_autoloader.lua inside autoexec while enabled.
Moves every RBA-managed loader, backup, disabled copy, and orphan temporary file outside autoexec when disabled.
Stores recoverable copies under Local AppData/RBA Autoexec Manager/loader-storage.
Restores a matching disabled loader from outside-autoexec storage when re-enabled.
